bytecode.description: What a deploy does with the V8 compile cache it warms for each node function.

embed.description: Fold each function's warmed compile cache into its own code package, so a cold start loads it with the code rather than fetching it from S3. Off, a cold start fetches it.

bytecode.title: BytecodeOptions

certificates.description: Certificates to serve a hostname with, keyed by hostname, valued by the ARN of an already-issued ACM certificate. A hostname left off gets a certificate ocel requests, validates and deletes again.

logs.description: How ocel logs --tail reads this account's logs.

liveTail.description: Tail through CloudWatch Live Tail: lower latency and no sampling gaps between polls, billed per session-minute past the free tier and capped at 15 sessions per account. Off, ocel logs --tail polls FilterLogEvents.

logs.title: LogOptions

region.description: The AWS region to deploy into, such as us-east-1: a region, never an availability zone such as us-east-1a. Omit it and ocel reads AWS_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, then the profile.

variablesKey.description: ARN of a KMS key to encrypt this account's variables under. Omit it and ocel bootstrap makes a key ocel owns, once a project here first seals a value.
